overviewHtml:
Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour – 11 Days

Discover the best of Nepal on an unforgettable 11-day Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan and Lumbini Tour. This carefully designed Nepal tour package combines ancient heritage, Himalayan scenery, wildlife adventures and Buddhist spirituality in one memorable journey.

Explore the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Kathmandu Valley, enjoy spectacular Himalayan views from Pokhara and Sarangkot, experience jungle activities in Chitwan National Park, and visit Lumbini, the sacred birthplace of Lord Buddha.

Whether you are traveling as a couple, family, solo traveler or small group, this easy-paced Nepal tour offers an ideal introduction to the country's culture, nature, wildlife and spiritual heritage.

Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour Highlights

  • Explore the UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Kathmandu Valley
  • Visit Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa and Swayambhunath
  • Discover the historic architecture of Patan and Kathmandu
  • Enjoy panoramic Himalayan views from Sarangkot
  • Explore beautiful Phewa Lake and Pokhara's major attractions
  • Experience adventure activities and leisure time in Pokhara
  • Enjoy jungle activities in Chitwan National Park
  • Experience traditional Tharu culture and village life
  • Visit Lumbini, the sacred birthplace of Lord Buddha
  • Explore Maya Devi Temple, Ashoka Pillar and international Buddhist monasteries
  • Travel through Nepal's diverse landscapes, from the Himalayan foothills to the Terai plains
  • Enjoy an easy-paced 11-day Nepal cultural, nature and wildlife tour

Why Choose the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour?

The Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour is an ideal choice for travelers who want to experience Nepal's culture, nature, wildlife and spiritual heritage without committing to a long trekking itinerary.

  • Four iconic Nepal destinations: Experience Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan and Lumbini in one carefully planned itinerary.
  • Rich cultural heritage: Explore ancient temples, stupas, palaces and UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
  • Himalayan scenery: Enjoy spectacular mountain views from Pokhara and Sarangkot.
  • Wildlife experience: Discover the natural beauty and wildlife of Chitwan National Park.
  • Buddhist heritage: Visit Lumbini, the sacred birthplace of Lord Buddha, and explore its monasteries and pilgrimage sites.
  • Easy-paced itinerary: The tour is suitable for travelers looking for sightseeing and cultural experiences without a demanding trek.
  • Suitable for different travelers: Ideal for couples, families, solo travelers and private groups.
  • Customizable travel: The itinerary can be adjusted according to your travel dates, interests and requirements.

Best Time for Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour

The best time for a Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour is generally during spring and autumn. From March to May, travelers can enjoy pleasant temperatures, blooming landscapes and good conditions for sightseeing. September to November is another excellent period, with generally clear skies, comfortable weather and impressive Himalayan views.

Winter can also be a good option for travelers who prefer cooler temperatures and fewer visitors, while summer and monsoon months bring more rainfall and can affect road travel and mountain visibility.

Because weather conditions can vary, travelers should choose their travel season according to their preferred activities and overall travel plans.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu 1345 m.
itinerary.description: Nepal Unique Treks staff will pick up you from International Airport Kathmandu, and drive to Thamel 6.5 km. Check-in Hotel. Overnight sleep at Thamel.

itinerary.title: Exploring Kathmandu Valley 1345 m.
itinerary.description: After breakfast in Hotel. Meeting with an agency that organize your trip in Nepal. Short briefing all about the tour and complete official agreements. Introduce your city guide who help you explore Nepa. Start your tour driving with a tourist private car. Our tour guide will bring you to explore Bouddhanath Stupa, Hindu Temple Pashupatinath, Patan Durbar squire, and Swayambhunath stupa. Early afternoon returns back to Hotel. Stroll around Thamel yourself. Overnight sleep at Hotel in Thamel.

itinerary.title: Drive from Kathmandu to Pokhara by Tourist bus 210 km, 810 m
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, your Tour guide will come to your Hotel. After having breakfast you will short hike to the Tourist bus station. 7 in the morning bus straight goes to Pokhara via the white water rafting river, beautiful local villages, agriculture fields, and landscape. the driver will stop for breakfast and lunch along the way. 7/8 hrs drive on tourist bus you will arrive at Pokhara. check-in Hotel. In the evening free time to stretch short hikes around the lake and enjoy dinner at Pokhara lakeside. Overnight sleep at Pokhara Hotel.

itinerary.title: Explore Mountain view from Sarangkot, Pokhara sightseeing. 810 m, 6hrs
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, a 40 m drive to Sarangkot viewpoint from where catch the magnificent Annapurna Himalayan Range with a stunning sunrise view and 360-degree panoramic view. The tour guide will let you know about more than 15 snow peak mountain which is over 6000 m high. Return back to the hotel. Take a warm breakfast and get ready to explore Pokhara Valley. Your day starts at the International Mountain museum. There are many things to know about mountaineering, Nepal's Geographical History, World record holder mountain climbers, flora and fauna, culture, religion, cast, and people's lifestyle. and they have a 20 m slide show or documentary about Uppermutang and Sherpa People. David falls, Gupteswar Mahadev Cave, World Peace Stupa, Taal Barahi Temple, Bindabasini Temple, and Old Pokhara is a major destinations in Pokhara for international and domestic tourists. Pokhara is the main point to start Annapurna Base Camp Trek, and the end of the Annapurna Circuit Trek Upper Mustang Trek so that in the Trekking session there would be crowded with tourists they are celebrating the completion of the Trek. Enjoy your evening around the lakeside and taste food from the Himalayan city of Pokhara.

itinerary.title: Enjoy the day doing by Adventurous Sports in Pokhara 810 m.
itinerary.description: Today is free time to do Adventure Sports in Pokhara like Paragliding, Jeep Flyer, and Bunjee Jumping. If you are interested in doing any sports talk with your tour guide or consult with your travel agency they will help to book the activities. Otherwise, if you are not interested in doing anything it will be your leisure day. Shopping, doing massage, and hanging around in Phewa lake or you will enjoy doing boating on the lake. Overnight sleep at Hotel.

itinerary.title: Drive from Pokhara to Chitwan National park
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive to Chitwan National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its wildlife and dense forests. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and enjoy a traditional Tharu cultural dance performance.

itinerary.title: Chitwan Jungle Activities
itinerary.description: Take a full-day jungle excursion, including a canoe ride on the Rapti River, an elephant safari, and a visit to the elephant breeding center. In the evening, enjoy a cultural program by the local Tharu people.

itinerary.title: Drive to Lumbini
itinerary.description: Drive to Lumbini, the birthplace of Lord Buddha and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Upon arrival, check into your hotel and explore the area around your hotel.

itinerary.title: Lumbini Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Take a full-day tour of Lumbini, visiting the Mayadevi Temple, Ashoka Pillar, and various monasteries built by Buddhist countries from around the world.

itinerary.title: Drive back to Kathmandu
itinerary.description: After breakfast, drive back to Kathmandu and check into your hotel. Spend the rest of the day at leisure, shopping for souvenirs or exploring the city on your own.

itinerary.title: Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Transfer to the airport for your departure flight back home, with unforgettable memories of your Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini tour.

usefulInfoHtml:
Traveller Useful Information

Kathmandu Valley is the cultural and historical heart of Nepal, offering an extraordinary blend of ancient temples, traditional architecture, vibrant local life, and spiritual heritage. A Kathmandu sightseeing tour provides travelers with the opportunity to discover the valley’s remarkable history while exploring some of the most important Kathmandu UNESCO sites.

Among the highlights is the sacred Pashupatinath Temple, one of the most revered Hindu temples in Nepal, located along the banks of the Bagmati River. Visitors can also explore the magnificent Boudhanath Stupa, one of the largest Buddhist stupas in Nepal and an important center of Tibetan Buddhist culture. Perched on a hill overlooking the Kathmandu Valley, Swayambhunath, also known as the Monkey Temple, offers panoramic views of the city along with a fascinating combination of Buddhist and Hindu traditions.

History and architecture enthusiasts can continue their journey to Patan Durbar Square, renowned for its beautifully preserved Newari architecture, ancient courtyards, temples, and artistic heritage. In the heart of the capital, Kathmandu Durbar Square showcases historic palaces, temples, statues, and monuments that reflect the grandeur of Nepal’s former royal kingdom.

Another essential attraction is Bhaktapur Durbar Square, a beautifully preserved historic square famous for its traditional Newari buildings, intricate wood carvings, pagodas, and cultural atmosphere. Together, these heritage attractions make Kathmandu Valley an exceptional destination for travelers interested in Nepal’s history, religion, art, and architecture.

Exploring the valley allows visitors to experience centuries-old traditions alongside the energy of modern Kathmandu, making it an essential part of any Nepal tour package. From sacred pilgrimage sites and ancient royal squares to Buddhist monuments and traditional neighborhoods, Kathmandu Valley offers a fascinating introduction to the diverse cultural heritage that makes Nepal a unique and memorable travel destination.

Pokhara is one of the most beautiful destinations in Nepal, famous for its peaceful lakes, spectacular Himalayan scenery, and exciting outdoor experiences. A Pokhara sightseeing tour offers travelers an opportunity to explore the natural and cultural attractions of this picturesque city while enjoying breathtaking views of the Annapurna and Dhaulagiri mountain ranges.

One of the most popular experiences is visiting Sarangkot, a scenic hill station renowned for its spectacular sunrise and sunset views over the Himalayas. On a clear morning, visitors can admire the golden light illuminating peaks such as Annapurna and Machhapuchhre, also known as Fishtail Mountain. The tranquil Phewa Lake is another major attraction and an ideal place to enjoy boating while taking in the surrounding mountain scenery.

Travelers can visit the Tal Barahi Temple located on an island in the lake and explore the lively Lakeside area, which offers restaurants, cafés, shops, and beautiful views. Other important attractions around Pokhara include Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, the World Peace Pagoda, and the International Mountain Museum. Pokhara is also considered one of Nepal’s premier adventure destinations, offering activities such as paragliding, zip-lining, boating, and hiking.

For travelers seeking a more relaxed experience, the city provides plenty of opportunities to enjoy nature, explore local culture, and experience peaceful moments beside the lake. Combining spectacular mountain landscapes with cultural attractions and adventure opportunities, Pokhara is an essential stop on any Nepal tour package.

Whether you are traveling with family, friends, as a couple, or independently, Pokhara offers an unforgettable experience and a perfect contrast to the historic atmosphere of Kathmandu Valley.

Chitwan National Park is one of Nepal’s most exciting destinations for nature and wildlife lovers, offering a completely different experience from the Himalayan landscapes of Kathmandu and Pokhara. Located in the southern Terai region of Nepal, the park is renowned for its rich biodiversity, dense forests, grasslands, rivers, and diverse wildlife. A Chitwan jungle safari provides travelers with an opportunity to explore this remarkable natural environment and observe wildlife in its natural habitat.

The park is particularly famous for the endangered one-horned rhinoceros and is also home to deer, wild boar, crocodiles, numerous species of birds, and other fascinating wildlife. Depending on the season and local conditions, visitors may have opportunities to explore the park through guided jungle activities, nature walks, canoe rides, and jeep safaris.

The Rapti River provides a beautiful setting for observing birds and aquatic wildlife while enjoying the peaceful surroundings of the park. In addition to its natural attractions, Chitwan offers an opportunity to experience the traditions and lifestyle of the local Tharu community. Visitors can learn about traditional village life, cultural customs, music, dance, and local heritage.

This combination of wildlife, nature, and culture makes Chitwan an important part of a comprehensive Nepal tour package. After exploring the historic temples of Kathmandu and the Himalayan scenery of Pokhara, Chitwan provides a refreshing change of environment and an opportunity to discover Nepal’s tropical lowlands.

Whether you are interested in wildlife photography, nature, birdwatching, or cultural experiences, a visit to Chitwan National Park adds an adventurous and memorable dimension to your Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour.

Lumbini Nepal is one of the most important spiritual and cultural destinations in the country and is recognized as the sacred birthplace of Siddhartha Gautama, who later became known as Lord Buddha. Listed as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, Lumbini attracts pilgrims, history enthusiasts, and travelers from around the world who come to explore its ancient monuments, peaceful gardens, monasteries, and religious heritage.

The central attraction is the Maya Devi Temple, traditionally regarded as the exact birthplace of Buddha. Inside the sacred area, visitors can explore archaeological remains and religious monuments associated with Buddha’s birth. Nearby, the Ashoka Pillar, erected by the Mauryan Emperor Ashoka during his pilgrimage to Lumbini, provides important historical evidence of the site's significance.

The Lumbini Development Zone also features numerous monasteries and temples built by Buddhist communities from different countries, creating a fascinating representation of Buddhist architecture and traditions from around the world. Visitors can spend time exploring the peaceful monastic areas, meditation spaces, sacred gardens, and surrounding archaeological sites.

A Lumbini tour offers more than sightseeing; it provides an opportunity to experience a peaceful atmosphere and learn about the life, teachings, and global influence of Buddha. As an important destination for Buddhist pilgrimage, Lumbini complements the cultural attractions of Kathmandu, the Himalayan scenery of Pokhara, and the wildlife experiences of Chitwan. Including Lumbini in a Nepal tour package allows travelers to discover another important aspect of Nepal’s diverse heritage.

For those interested in spirituality, history, religion, architecture, and culture, Lumbini is an unforgettable destination and an essential highlight of the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour.

liveFaqs.question: How many days are enough for Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan and Lumbini?
liveFaqs.answer: An 11-day itinerary is ideal for exploring Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan and Lumbini comfortably. This Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour allows enough time for sightseeing, cultural experiences, Himalayan views, wildlife activities and Buddhist heritage without making the journey too rushed.

liveFaqs.question: What are the highlights of the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour?
liveFaqs.answer: The major highlights include exploring Kathmandu UNESCO sites, visiting Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa and Swayambhunath, sightseeing in Pokhara, enjoying Sarangkot sunrise and Phewa Lake, experiencing Chitwan National Park, and visiting Lumbini, the birthplace of Lord Buddha.

liveFaqs.question: What can I see during Kathmandu sightseeing?
liveFaqs.answer: Kathmandu sightseeing includes some of Nepal's most important cultural and historical attractions. Depending on the itinerary, you can visit Pashupatinath Temple, Boudhanath Stupa, Swayambhunath, Kathmandu Durbar Square, Patan Durbar Square and Bhaktapur Durbar Square.

liveFaqs.question: What are the main attractions in Pokhara?
liveFaqs.answer: Pokhara is famous for its Himalayan scenery and natural attractions. Popular places include Sarangkot, Phewa Lake, Davis Falls, Gupteshwor Cave, the World Peace Pagoda and the International Mountain Museum. Travelers can also enjoy boating and various adventure activities.

liveFaqs.question: What wildlife can I see in Chitwan National Park?
liveFaqs.answer: Chitwan National Park is well known for its one-horned rhinoceros, deer, crocodiles and diverse bird species. Depending on the season and wildlife conditions, visitors may also have opportunities to see other animals during jungle safaris and guided nature activities.

liveFaqs.question: What is special about Lumbini Nepal?
liveFaqs.answer: Lumbini Nepal is internationally recognized as the birthplace of Lord Buddha and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Major attractions include Maya Devi Temple, the Ashoka Pillar, sacred gardens and monasteries representing different Buddhist traditions from around the world.

liveFaqs.question: Is the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour suitable for families?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes, this Nepal tour package can be suitable for families, couples, senior travelers and private groups. The itinerary combines cultural sightseeing, nature, wildlife and relaxation without requiring strenuous trekking.

liveFaqs.question: What is the best time for this Nepal tour?
liveFaqs.answer: Spring (March to May) and autumn (September to November) are generally considered excellent seasons for the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour. These periods usually offer comfortable sightseeing conditions and good opportunities for Himalayan views.

liveFaqs.question: Can I customize the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes. The itinerary can be customized according to your travel dates, interests, preferred transportation, hotel category and available time. You can also discuss adding extra days in Kathmandu, Pokhara, Chitwan or Lumbini.

liveFaqs.question: Is this tour suitable for travelers who do not want to trek?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes. The Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour is primarily a sightseeing, cultural, nature and wildlife journey rather than a trekking trip. It is an excellent option for travelers who want to experience Nepal without undertaking a multi-day Himalayan trek.

liveFaqs.question: How do I book the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour?
liveFaqs.answer: To book the tour, contact Nepal Unique Treks with your preferred travel dates, group size and requirements. The tour operator can provide current availability, pricing, accommodation options and transportation details before you confirm your trip.

liveFaqs.question: Can I combine this tour with a Nepal trekking package?
liveFaqs.answer: Yes. Travelers with additional time can combine the Kathmandu Pokhara Chitwan Lumbini Tour with a trekking adventure such as the Annapurna region or another suitable Himalayan trek. The itinerary can be extended based on your interests, fitness level and travel schedule.
